initialization: original pretrained weights for every model, LR and seed; do not reuse fixed-update checkpoints
selection: seed42 validation probe R2 after complete 1800-second budget; never test
schedule: cosine over remaining wall time after warmup; minimum multiplier 0.1
ia_reference: existing 9762-update final IA runs, approximately 31.5 min on A100; not exactly equal wall time
timer: training loop wall time including periodic checkpoint IO, excludes tokenization/model load/evaluation; completes current optimizer update at threshold
